evidence.note: Enumerates seed requirements against actual counts (11 accounts, 24 statuses, 10 hashtags, 2 CW) — a running checklist that reconciles targets vs actuals.
Explicit ✅/❌ status lists mapping tested items (accounts/statuses/hashtags/CW/media counts, auth, follow, favourite) — genuine verified-vs-pending tracking, though re-derived in prose each time.

Repeatedly nearly marked complete then caught unaddressed gaps (UI compose auth, mixed auth, home-timeline auth). Shows self-correction but also an incomplete done-vs-remaining picture that let it almost submit with broken subsystems.

Route-ordering bug recurred (search then relationships) and duplicate routes/compose forms from its own patches had to be hunted down — indicating partial loss of state over its own edits, though each was eventually detected.

The 19 pytest gates and the large realism surface (palette, button label, visibility icons, introspection, admin scopes, poll/media/trend env vars) are named but never individually tracked or verified — whole subsystems left off the ledger.

reasoning: The agent keeps usable, updated checklists and even uses ✅/❌ reconciliation with real counts for the seed and core-functional subset, and it detects incomplete state well enough to abort premature completions — clearly above the level-5 'usable running checklist.' But it re-derives status in prose rather than maintaining an explicit granular ledger of the full requirement set, and large portions of the surface (introspection, list/admin-scope depth, time-compression env vars, and the entire realism gate) go untracked and unverified, while recurring route bugs and self-inflicted duplicate routes show some loss of state — falling short of the level-8 'explicit granular status of the full requirement set + thrashing recognition.' This lands at a 6.
